result.hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT (Q1 FY27 presentation): revenue Rs525.6 cr (+39.9% YoY) on higher realisations with lower volumes (-10-12%); EBITDA Rs117.1 cr (+202.6%), margin 22.28% vs 12.31% FY26, 8.96% FY25; PAT Rs78.9 cr; EPS Rs15.23 (vs FY26 full-year Rs19.56).

bear.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: West Asia disruption ends, spreads normalise, margin back to ~11-12%, FY28 PAT ~Rs115 cr, 14x

base.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Margin settles ~14-15% (above FY26 12.3%), revenue ~Rs1,700 cr, 15x

bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Elevated spreads persist, domestic volume +10% continues, margin ~18%, 16x

risk.cycle: HIGH: margin 2x its FY24-FY26 range, driven by a supply disruption
risk.order_firmness: unknown; commodity/spec products, no order book

result.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 is real (EBITDA +203%, margin 22%) but the driver is pricing and constrained supply during the West Asia/Hormuz disruption, with raw-material pass-through and inventory gains (management: ~2% of margin). Volumes fell 10-12% as exports suffered; domestic volume +10%. This is a cyclical windfall rather than a structural inflection: margin is 2x the 9-12% of the past three years. At 17x trailing EPS the price looks cheap only if the peak persists. Capex plans exist but are not quantified in the extracted text.
chain_missing_links: Structural demand/capacity link: growth is price, volumes down
Durability of margin: tied to a geopolitical supply shock
result.demand_signal: Domestic volume +10% YoY; export volume down (Hormuz/MENA); total volume -10-12% (MANAGEMENT CLAIM, Q1 FY27 call).
result.supply_signal: Management: able to 'capitalize on constrained market supply' (MANAGEMENT CLAIM); temporary and war-linked.
result.pricing_signal: Realisations up with input cost pass-through; EBITDA margin 22.3% vs 10.3% a year ago (FACT). ~2% of EBITDA margin from inventory gains (MANAGEMENT CLAIM).
result.capacity_catalyst: Taloja 103,000 MTPA latex + 7,000 MTPA HSR; Valia 21,000 MTPA nitrile rubber + 50,000 MTPA nitrile latex (FACT, presentation). Strategic capex 'in execution', size and date unknown.
result.cfo_to_pat: 2.01 FY26 (dossier, healthy); working capital rose in Q1 on higher input prices (MANAGEMENT CLAIM)
result.debt: ND/EBITDA 0.31, interest cover 54.5; ICRA [ICRA]AA-(Stable) reaffirmed 26 Aug 2026 with enhanced limits (FACT)
result.valuation: Mcap Rs2,808 cr, TTM P/E 17.4, EV/EBITDA 14.8, PEG 0.06 (dossier; PEG distorted by peak-quarter EPS). Annualising Q1 EPS (~Rs61) is not a normalised base; FY26 EPS Rs19.56. -20.5% from 52-week high.

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs70 at 15x, i.e. Q1 margin sustained for years

kill_conditions: Ceasefire/Hormuz reopening followed by spread compression and inventory losses
catalysts: Resolution of West Asia disruption (negative for margin, positive for export volume)
result.biggest_risk: Margin mean reversion when supply normalises; peak-cycle earnings flattering the P/E.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: EBITDA margin vs 22.3%, domestic vs export volumes, inventory gain disclosure, working capital
